footer.tagline: LearnRise is your learning GPS. Precise, adaptive roadmaps that turn any goal into a resourced path.

hero.title: Your Learning <gps>GPS</gps>.
hero.subtitle: LearnRise turns any learning goal into a personalized, adaptive roadmap that recalculates as you progress. Like Google Maps, but for learning.

auth.panelSubtitle: Set a destination and LearnRise plots the route: resourced, ordered, and adaptive.
auth.panelFeat1: Never wonder what to study next
auth.panelFeat3: An AI tutor that knows your path
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to pick up where you left off.
auth.linkInvalid: That sign-in link was invalid or expired. Please try again.
auth.signupSubtitle: It only takes an email and a password. Your first journey is free.

auth.verifySubtitle: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.

auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send reset instructions.

auth.setNewSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.linkExpiredSubtitle: This password reset link is no longer valid.

auth.passwordUpdatedSubtitle: You're signed in with your new password.

pricingPage.title: Invest in your <grad>learning journey</grad>.
pricingPage.subtitle: Choose the path that fits your goals. From casual exploration to intensive professional mastery, LearnRise guides every step.
pricingPage.freeTierDesc: Essential tools to start your journey.

sidebar.upgradeDesc: Unlock adaptive tutor and multi-journey memory sync.

dashboard.title: My Learning Journeys
dashboard.subtitle: Precision-mapped pathways across your professional and intellectual landscape.
dashboard.dragHint: Drag a journey card onto a folder to file it.
dashboard.folderEmpty: This folder is empty. Drag journey cards onto the folder to file them here.
dashboard.folderContents: Journeys in this folder. Remove one to send it back to your dashboard.

journeyCard.deleteDesc: It moves to Archive for 30 days, so you can restore it if you change your mind.

addJourney.limitDesc: The free tier includes one active journey. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited journeys, AI summarizing, and the adaptive tutor.

help.title: How to use LearnRise
help.subtitle: A quick in-depth guide to getting the most out of your learning GPS.

startJourney.title: Start a journey
startJourney.body: Tap the dashed “Add Journey” card, describe your goal, level, timeline, and preferences. LearnRise generates a mapped roadmap.

followRoadmap.title: Follow the roadmap
followRoadmap.body: Each journey is split into units and chapters. Expand a unit to see its resources, or click into a unit for the full flowchart view.

trackProgress.title: Track progress
trackProgress.body: Check off resources as you complete them. Progress bars update per unit and for the whole journey.

askMetis.title: Ask LearnRise
askMetis.body: Open the Ask LearnRise panel on any journey to ask questions, re-plan your schedule with the Planner, or work through a concept with the Tutor.

keepStreak.title: Keep your streak
keepStreak.body: Study a little every day. Your streak counter and calendar track consistency across all journeys.

organizeFolders.title: Organize with folders
organizeFolders.body: Group related journeys or saved resources into folders to keep your dashboard tidy.

addFolder.title: New folder
addFolder.subtitle: Group journeys or resources together. Give your folder a name.

notificationsPage.title: My Notifications
notificationsPage.emptyBody: Streak reminders and journey nudges will show up here.

journeyPage.notFoundDesc: This journey doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

curation.paused: Paused, {what} hit its rate limit{retry}. It resumes on its own.
curation.fillInfo: LearnRise fills these in a few at a time. Keep this page open and they'll finish automatically.

chapterStatus.curating: LearnRise is curating resources for this chapter…
chapterStatus.gap: No resources found yet, this chapter is flagged as a gap.

ask.title: LearnRise AI Tutor

tutor.label: Tutor
tutor.blurb: Work through a concept step by step

intro.main: Hi, I'm LearnRise. Ask me anything about this journey. I can also re-plan upcoming units or refresh a chapter's resources if you ask.
intro.planner: I'm your Planner. Tell me your deadline, weekly hours, or how you want to re-pace things and I'll re-plan your upcoming chapters (finished ones stay put).
intro.tutor: I'm your Tutor. Point me at a concept or resource and I'll walk you through it, questions first, answers second.

planner: I have less time this week
Skip ahead to a different topic
tutor: I'm stuck, give me a hint

ask.limitSubtitle: You've used all of today's free messages. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited chat with LearnRise.
ask.errorRespond: LearnRise couldn't respond. Please try again.
ask.roadmapUpdating: Updating your roadmap, new units and resources will appear shortly.

createJourney.generatingBody: LearnRise is researching a syllabus and mapping your units and chapters. This usually takes 15 to 30 seconds, hang tight and keep this open. Resources fill in afterward.
createJourney.title: Create a new learning journey
createJourney.subtitle: Tell LearnRise what you want to learn. It'll generate a mapped roadmap, the more specific you are, the better the route.
createJourney.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Ace the AP Biology genetics unit, be as specific as possible.
createJourney.currentLevelPlaceholder: Where are you starting from? Be as specific as possible.
createJourney.preferencesPlaceholder: e.g. prefer videos and interactive practice over long readings.
createJourney.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

flowchart.knowledgeMap: Knowledge map, what you'll learn in this unit
flowchart.topicsHint: {count, plural, one {# topic} other {# topics}} · hover a node to mark your mastery

analytics.title: {name}'s Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Your learning momentum across all journeys.
analytics.freeSubtitle: Analytics & progress insights are a Pro feature. Upgrade to unlock streaks, trends, and per-journey breakdowns.
analytics.emptyBody: As you study and complete resources, your streaks, trends, and per-journey breakdown will appear here.

overview.notShownBody: total study time and per-message chat history aren't tracked anywhere in the app today, there's no session/duration log, and the chat memory table stores one compressed summary per journey rather than a timestamped history. Everything above is computed from real completion data instead of estimated.

trends.consistencySub: Resources completed per day, across all journeys

archive.subtitle: Journeys you've completed or removed.
archive.completedEmpty: No completed journeys yet. Finish a journey and it'll be archived here.
archive.deletedInfo: Deleted journeys can be restored any time before they're permanently deleted.

resources.subtitle: Everything you've saved from your journeys, in one hub.
resources.dragHint: Drag a resource onto a folder to file it.

resources.folderEmpty: This folder is empty. Drag saved resources onto the folder to file them here.
resources.folderContents: Resources in this folder. Remove one to send it back to your saved list.

settings.title: Profile & Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account. Name and email changes are saved to your LearnRise account (email changes require confirmation via inbox link).
settings.avatarHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF · up to 3 MB.
settings.passwordHelp: To change your password, use the <link>password reset flow</link>. We'll email you a secure link.
settings.languageHelp: New journeys, their resources, and the tutor are generated in {lang}. Existing journeys keep the language they were created in.

settings.planStatusPremium: You're currently on the Premium plan.
settings.dangerDesc: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.
